LanguageData.WotF_ElfXenotype.description: A slender, long-lived elven people. Born with a constitution quite unlike ordinary humans, they seem able to invoke a force called "magic" directly without relying on any external device. As for where they truly come from, or why they feel an almost instinctive kinship with the forest, even most elves themselves cannot clearly say.
LanguageData.WotF_ElfXenotype.descriptionShort: A long-lived people naturally attuned to magic, dwelling deep in untrodden forests.
LanguageData.WotF_ElfXenotype.label: elf
